title: The tablebase lab

D0.outcome: Explains what a tablebase result means (exact for seven pieces or fewer) and how to test a conjecture with it.

D1.outcome: Given a conjecture about an ending, writes a test position and predicts its result.

D2.outcome: Writes a short conclusion backed by a verified family and a failing look-alike.

D3.outcome: Investigates a claim from a source with tablebase evidence and writes a conclusion another learner can check.

misconceptions: A tablebase explains why a position is won.
sources: docs/reconciliation-pasted-curriculum.md §2 (Dvoretsky Endgame Analysis as a model)
conditions: At most seven pieces; results are exact.
contrasts: A position with more than seven pieces, where no tablebase answer exists.
Quoting the result without a human-checkable reason.
